prompt: Jon read every night after brushing his teeth. He moves house, his routine changes, and the reading stops even though he still enjoys it. Which part of the habit loop best explains the failure?

options.text: The reward was too small to ever work
He was relying on willpower instead of a system
The familiar cue that triggered the routine disappeared, so the routine was never prompted
Reading is not a habit that can become automatic

explanation: The routine and reward did not change; the cue did. Re-attaching reading to a new stable cue in the new home, such as after locking the front door, restores the trigger.
